description: For up to 16 Robinhood stock tokens: Robinhood's live feed per token (bid, ask, spread, day's range), the stock's last regular and extended-hours trades, the token's deepest on-chain pool, and chainPremium, how far the pool sits above or below the feed's midpoint. Off hours a gap larger than the full cost of a trade may be worth taking.
name: get_stock_quotes
title: Stock tokens: Robinhood's feed against the on-chain price
